scope.physicalForgetfulAction: identity on Q,u_c,d_c,L,e_c,H and the Standard Model gauge fields

theorem.statement: Every local operator generated from the current physical fields, Standard Model invariant tensors, Lorentz contractions and endpoint-blind coefficients is exchange-even at every effective dimension.
theorem.reason: The forgetful map sends both Furey survivors to the same physical field representation and intertwines their exchange with the identity.
theorem.consequence: No source-derived B_minus exists in the current 15-state field content.

candidateClasses.verdict: No gauge-singlet holomorphic fermion bilinear exists among Q,u_c,d_c,L,e_c.
n_mu psi_dagger sigma_bar^mu psi is allowed but endpoint-blind; an odd weighting requires the missing P_minus spurion and is state-dependent rather than a topology eigenvalue.
A physical-field kinetic term is identical for the two embeddings; inserting P_minus assumes the portal.
The same Q u_c H, Q d_c H_dagger and L e_c H_dagger operators occur in both survivors. An imaginary part of one Yukawa is rephasing-dependent and does not measure endpoint orientation.

candidateClasses.gaugeLorentzCompatible: conditional on standard quantization and boundary completion
candidateClasses.verdict: Gauge and gravitational connections are unchanged by O1 <-> R; their characteristic classes cannot distinguish the survivors.
Both survivors have the same vanishing perturbative anomaly vector and even weak-doublet parity, so the difference inflow polynomial is zero.
Formally works only after adjoining P_minus=P_O1-P_R; this is the missing internal datum, not a composite of the current physical fields.
After adjoining one sterile Weyl N~(1,1)_0 and identifying the reverse Furey arrow by the CAR real structure, B_minus=i(NN-(NN)^dagger) is the smallest field-based candidate.

minimalExtension.field: one left-handed sterile Weyl fermion N per completed generation
conditions: the exchange/CAR map sends NN to (NN)^dagger
the unique D->E neutral arrow has fermionic Lorentz character
the reverse arrow is not an independent sterile species
the coupling correlates the selected neutral-arrow orientation with the charged 15-state topology
minimalExtension.fallbackIfCARFails: two independent sterile Weyl fields or an independent exchange-odd order parameter are required; this is no longer the minimal one-field completion

radiativeStability.stableStatement: Counterterms preserve the paired form if the combined exchange is exact in the regulator and boundary conditions.
radiativeStability.unstableStatement: With fixed chi and no exact combined symmetry, gauge invariance alone permits both CP-even and CP-odd sterile masses and does not protect portal alignment.
radiativeStability.requiredAudit: derive the CAR exchange, regulator and boundary condition; compute whether LNH loops mix the odd and even sterile mass operators

falsifiers: the Furey D->E arrow cannot be assigned the sterile Weyl Lorentz/CAR structure
the reverse arrow is independently quantized and creates an unwanted sterile Dirac pair
boundary reversal does not reverse the Majorana pseudoscalar response
radiative counterterms destroy the combined exchange without a protecting symmetry
the neutral portal does not correlate with which charged TRO is realized
a current-field composite is found whose physical correlators distinguish O1 from R without an endpoint-labelled coefficient
